problem_statement: The networking IP address helpers can create and detect an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (an address of the form ::ffff:a.b.c.d that embeds an IPv4 address), but there is no way to recover the original IPv4 address from such a mapped IPv6 address. A helper is needed that, given an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address, fills in a struct net_in_addr whose value, compared in network byte order, exactly equals the IPv4 address that was used to create the mapped address (e.g. extracting from an address derived from 192.168.0.1 yields 192.168.0.1). A plain, non-mapped IPv6 address must not be reported as IPv4-mapped.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/ip-addr -s tests/net/ip-addr/net.ip-addr -s net.ip-addr -O twister-out --no-clean -W
